description.value: Gibsons Public Art Gallery (GPAG) is a free non-profit public gallery housed in the historic former Bank of Montreal building at the centre of Gibsons' Landing on BC's Sunshine Coast. Founded in 2003, it anchors a creative district that includes five commercial galleries, artists' studios, and a heritage museum. Gibsons is a 40-minute ferry ride from Vancouver, making GPAG a natural cultural pause for cyclists touring the Sunshine Coast.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website at gpag.ca confirms the gallery's address (431 Marine Drive, Gibsons, BC), phone (604-886-0531), and email (info@gpag.ca), all matching OSM values; the /visit/ page explicitly corroborates OSM wheelchair=yes. No cycling-specific amenities — bike racks, water refill, or washrooms — are mentioned anywhere on the website, leaving all required criteria null. The website header displays placeholder contact details (+321 123 4567, info@example.com) that are clearly WordPress theme demo artifacts, not real contact data; the footer and /visit/ page carry the correct information.
concerns: Website header shows placeholder contact details (+321 123 4567, info@example.com) that are WordPress theme demo artifacts; real contact info in the footer and /visit/ page matches OSM correctly.
OSM opening_hours (Mo-Su 11:00-16:00) indicates the gallery is open every day, but the website shows Tuesday and Wednesday as closed — OSM hours appear outdated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: GPAG is a legitimate, active free public attraction that is a credible cultural stop for Sunshine Coast cyclists, but none of the required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are confirmed from available evidence — direct contact or a site visit is needed before listing.
enrichment_extras.notes: Wheelchair accessible with designated parking confirmed by website. Free admission. Gallery is housed in the former Bank of Montreal building.
